```{r setup, include=FALSE}
library(reach.postproc)
render_mermaid <- function(diagram) {
  if (requireNamespace("DiagrammeR", quietly = TRUE)) return(DiagrammeR::mermaid(diagram))
  knitr::asis_output(paste0("```mermaid\n", diagram, "\n```"))
}
```

# Round trip

```{r roundtrip}
p1<-default_ar_parameters();z1<-roots(p1)@values;p2<-roots_to_parameters(z1)
p1@coefficients;p2@coefficients
```

Modal time zero is forecast step one in `decompose_ar()`.
